reason: The free one-pager is fine, but $950 to $2,500 for a guy out of Roscoe who I have never worked with is money I would rather put into a turn on a vacant unit. I am not signing up for a written test that I would have to define with him before I even know if he is good.
objection: I do not have time to sit in meetings about this, and the balance only when it passes the test line just means I would be the one arguing about what passing means. I have been burned by contractors who wrote their own report card.
would_change_my_mind: A fixed, small first step I can see the work on before paying anything, like a free one-pager on one of my actual properties plus a flat $250 trial on something blind-spot simple, like missed-call follow-up, with the test written in plain numbers (X calls returned in Y hours) and a reference from a property manager near me who will take my call.
